space.label: The Space
space.title: A Tiki Bar Built Right
body: The Lobby occupies the ground floor of The Brick Hotel on Pier View Way, steps from the Oceanside Pier. The space is designed to feel like a destination — bamboo, tiki carvings, beaded curtains, tropical foliage, and warm golden light that sets the tone from the moment you walk in.

The bar program is anchored by an extensive rum selection. Every spirit is chosen to serve a role in the cocktail program — nothing is here by accident. The island-inspired kitchen runs alongside, with plates built to complement what’s in the glass.
space.imageAlt: The Lobby Tiki Bar Oceanside CA — beaded curtains, tiki carvings, booth seating

rum.label: The Bar Program
rum.title: The Rum Program
body: The rum selection at The Lobby is built to serve the cocktail menu, not the other way around. Every bottle earns its place — Jamaican pot still rums for the Cobra Kai, aged Barbados rum for depth, agricole for brightness, overproof for float work.
Falernum, orgeat, Fassionola, coconut cream — the modifiers are as intentional as the spirits. Fresh juice throughout. This is how tiki is supposed to be done.
